During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''battle''' was fought over [[Derilyn]]. An [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] force infiltrated [[Derilyn Space Defense Platform]] with a mission to destroy the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Brazen]]''. During the mission, the [[Khuiumin Survivors]], contacted by Alliance [[operative]] [[Shondra Del]], arrived and assault the Imperial forces, aiding in the Alliance team's escape. The ''Brazen'' was destroyed by bombs planted by the Alliance team, which also caused extensive damage to the Derilyn Space Defense Platform.<ref name="OE" />
